channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Senate Republicans Block Efforts to Investigate Trump's IRS Audit
item.description: Senate Finance Committee Republicans voted down Democratic attempts to stop the Trump administration from shielding the president's tax audit.

item.title: Federal Judge Blocks DOJ Access to New Jersey Voter Rolls
item.description: Judge Zahid Quraishi barred the Justice Department from obtaining New Jersey's unredacted voter registration list, citing privacy concerns.

item.title: Democrats Investigate Deadly Iranian Drone Strike on US Troops
item.description: Congressional Democrats have launched a probe into the Iranian drone attack that killed six American service members in Kuwait earlier this year.

item.title: Sabato's Crystal Ball: Ossoff Now Favored in Georgia Race
item.description: The University of Virginia's election forecast upgraded Senator Jon Ossoff's reelection bid from "leans Democratic" to "likely Democratic."
